_provisional_note: NOT FOR DEPLOYMENT. This exists to be replayed against, not to be run. It differs from shadow-v1 in one number: confidence_min, lowered because the live run of 2026-09-22 showed 11 of 20 observed confidences below 0.80, which sent 4 of 5 candidates to REVIEW including the clean PAY case. 0.50 is the lowest value that recovers that case on this sample; it is NOT a calibrated figure. Five candidates in one run cannot calibrate a threshold, and Jev drifts about 0.05 between runs. Choosing a real value still needs human labels, per docs/labeling.md. Replay with: guard replay --policy policies/shadow-v2-candidate.json
_confidence_min_note: confidence_min is the most volatile knob: set it too high and nearly everything becomes REVIEW, too low and REVIEW never fires. Check the REVIEW share in the first shadow run and report it if it lands at either extreme.
_retry_detection_note: TODO: no host purchase flow exists yet, so the retry convention is unknown. Only a host-set idempotency_key or an explicit retry_of marker counts as a retry; every other reappearance of a request_id is recorded as DUPLICATE_REQUEST_ID and sent to REVIEW. Revisit once the host flow exists.

hook._hook_timeout_note: TODO: only used by the synchronous fallback. Set it from the measured duration of the host's existing purchase call, and keep jev.timeout_ms below it - the per-request timeout is what actually bounds the wait. Async mode is the default and does not read it.
hook._max_pending_note: Candidates accepted but not yet written. Past this the payment path drops rather than waits; a drop costs one shadow record, waiting would cost payment latency.
hook._shutdown_drain_note: How long a shutting-down process may spend flushing queued candidates. Anything left is counted and logged, never silently lost.

pricing._pricing_note: TODO: unset, so usage.cost_usd stays null rather than being guessed. Fill both rates and cite the TypeSafe price list in `source` before reading any cost figure from `guard report`.

ledger._dsn_note: Name of the environment variable holding the connection string. The string itself is never written to config, logs, the ledger, or error messages.

report._orphan_note: A candidate_observed with no guard_evaluated older than this counts as orphaned: the observation was recorded but its judgment never was.

_known_unfixed: Two problems this file does NOT address. (1) Rule 5 gates on questions that are not deciding the outcome: cand_pay_clean clears every score threshold yet is held for low confidence in task_fit and evidence_sufficiency, neither of which would have changed the verdict. Fixing that means changing the aggregation, not a threshold. (2) evidence_sufficiency scored below 0.80 on every candidate including the well-specified one, with low confidence in its own answer, which suggests the question is read differently than intended. Rewording it requires re-running the live check.
